incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: high-error-rate detected on /v1/generate for model-redwood/v2026-03-2 (canary cohort) — severity: P2. Pager: @Jordan
Maya (eng-runtime): I rolled v2026-03-2 to canary 5m ago. Seeing tokenization errors + garbled outputs on longer contexts.
Jordan (oncall): Got the page, jumping in. Any quick signal on whether it's weights vs tokenizer?
Maya (eng-runtime): Initial diff from CI: weights bundle ID b-7890 was promoted but tokenizer config stayed at tokenizer:v2 (should be v2.1). Looks like a config drift during artifact promotion.
Priya (eng-sre): Confirming from deploy-bot logs: `deploy-bot: promoted weights b-7890 -> prod-canary` but `tokenizer-tag` didn't update. Likely a release script race.
Sam (support-lead): Any customer-facing impact yet? Which orgs hit the canary?
Maya (eng-runtime): Canary traffic is ~0.5% of requests. But we see a 12% error rate (tokenization mismatch) on canary nodes. Top caller orgs: org-147 and org-332 — Sam, please prepare templates.
Jordan (oncall): Reproduced locally with a sample prompt: it splits tokens oddly and generation injects "�" characters around quotes.
Maya (eng-runtime): Paste of error from canary logs:
```
ERROR: tokenizer-vocab-mismatch: expected 50257 got 50269
context: model=redwood/v2026-03-2 shard=s-12
stack: Tokenizer.check_vocab -> Tokenizer.encode -> InferenceRuntime.generate
```
Priya (eng-sre): Ok. Two immediate mitigations: 1) flip feature flag to route canary -> fallback model variant (v2026-02-9) 2) rollback canary weights promotion. Which is faster?
Jordan (oncall): Flip flag first for immediate stop to bad outputs. Priya, can you flip? I'll coordinate rollback after.
Priya (eng-sre): Flipping flag now: `redwood-ff toggle canary_use_fallback v2026-03-2 false`
Priya (eng-sre): :white_check_mark: flag flipped — canary traffic should now route to fallback model v2026-02-9. Monitoring.
incident-bot: Change recorded: feature-flag canary_use_fallback toggled by Priya at 16:14:02 UTC.
Maya (eng-runtime): Confirming success — error rate dropped back to baseline within 30s on canary cohort. Good.
Sam (support-lead): Notifying affected customers: drafting update for org-147, org-332: quick note that we observed degraded generative outputs in a limited canary and traffic was routed away. ETA for root cause update: 1h.
Jordan (oncall): Next step: roll back the bad weights promotion so other clusters don't pick this up. Maya, can you rollback artifact in artifacts service and revoke the tag?
Maya (eng-runtime): Running rollback: `artifacts promote rollback --bundle b-7890 --target canary`
Maya (eng-runtime): Rollback complete. Also pushing a short-term guard: deploy pipeline now rejects weight promotions if tokenizer tag mismatch. Patch: `ci/guard/tokenizer-check` added.
Priya (eng-sre): Running canary smoke checks against restored canary (v2026-02-9). All clear so far. Latency normal, tokenization stable.
Jordan (oncall): Passing back to Priya for post-mitigation monitoring. I'll update the incident record and escalate to oncall-handoff to Priya for next 2 hours.
Sam (support-lead): Posted status update to status.redwood.ai: "Partial regression detected in limited canary; traffic automatically routed to safe variant. No customer-facing outage. Investigating root cause."
Maya (eng-runtime): Root cause summary so far: release script promoted weights without syncing tokenizer metadata — a race condition in promotion job that reads two separate artifact stores. Fixes: 1) atomic promotion transaction, 2) CI check for tokenizer/weights tag parity, 3) add metric alert for tokenizer-vocab-mismatch.
Jordan (oncall): Any idea how this passed pre-release checks?
Maya (eng-runtime): Our pre-release smoke only tests inference with the packaged artifact. The tokenizer mismatch appears only when runtime pulls tokenizer from central registry by tag. We'll change smoke to simulate registry pull in CI.
Priya (eng-sre): Action items assigned: Maya -> hotfix CI guard + promote rollback audit (ETA 2h). Maya/Priya -> extra canary gate for tokenizer parity (ETA 4h). Sam -> customer comms follow-up + support tickets for org-147/org-332. Jordan -> post-incident oncall notes + pagerduty postmortem link.
incident-bot: Incident P2 created: INC-324000-1 — Bad model version rollout (tokenizer mismatch). Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-324000-1
Sam (support-lead): Logged support tickets for the two orgs and sent the initial notification. Keeping them on the update loop.
Priya (eng-sre): Handing monitoring to Jordan -> Priya handoff complete. I'll keep an eye on metrics for 2h.
Jordan (oncall): Thanks team. We'll run a short blameless postmortem and include patch timeline. If anyone sees regression re-spawn in other clusters, ping immediately. :thumbsup:
Maya (eng-runtime): Quick note for follow-up: check autosync job that reconciles tokenizers across regions — possible partial propagation created window for mismatch.
Sam (support-lead): Will add customer impact details to the incident ticket after we verify logs.
Priya (eng-sre): Closing this thread for live mitigation steps. Keeping incident open for RCA.
Jordan (oncall): Closing pager on-call. Leaving incident in monitoring state.
